Memory layers

Four places memory lives. Agent writes all of them.
Hot cache
.claude/memory/MEMORY.md
Date-tagged one-liners + a current-state header. Capped 180 lines.
Handoffs
context/handoffs/*.md
One note per closed session — what happened, what's next.
Wiki
knowledge/concepts/*.md
Facts + rationale, promoted from repeated patterns.
Rules
.claude/rules/*.md
Always/never constraints. Mechanical, enforceable.
Promotion: pattern → article → rule. Always agent-written. Never user-edited.
